_note: Starter rule set for the baseline. Rules are illustrative and MUST be validated against the official Databricks Runtime release notes and Apache Spark migration guides before being relied on. 'introduced_in' is the first Databricks Runtime (DBR) version where the change is assumed to apply.

rules.title: Modules removed in Python 3.12 (distutils, imp)
rules.description: Python 3.12 removed the distutils and imp modules. Runtimes that ship Python 3.12 fail with ImportError on code that still imports them.
rules.recommendation: Replace distutils.version.LooseVersion with packaging.version.Version and imp with importlib.

rules.title: ANSI SQL mode enabled by default (Spark 4.0)
rules.description: With ANSI mode on, invalid casts and malformed date strings raise errors instead of returning null, and integer overflow raises an error.
rules.recommendation: Use try_cast / try_to_date where dirty input is expected, or set spark.sql.ansi.enabled=false explicitly. Update tests that assert on null results for bad input.

rules.title: DataFrame.registerTempTable is deprecated
rules.description: registerTempTable has been deprecated since Spark 2.0 in favour of createOrReplaceTempView.

rules.title: SQLContext is deprecated
rules.description: SQLContext and HiveContext have been superseded by SparkSession since Spark 2.0 and are deprecated.

rules.title: PandasUDFType is deprecated
rules.description: Pandas UDF types (PandasUDFType.SCALAR etc.) were deprecated in Spark 3.0 in favour of Python type hints.
rules.recommendation: Declare the UDF with Python type hints, e.g. def f(s: pd.Series) -> pd.Series.

rules.title: RDD API usage
rules.description: The RDD API is not available on all compute types (for example standard access mode clusters and serverless compute).
rules.recommendation: Rewrite with DataFrame operations (mapInPandas, mapPartitions equivalents) or run on a compute type that supports RDDs.

rules.title: DBFS mounts
rules.description: Mount points (dbutils.fs.mount, /mnt paths, /dbfs/mnt) are a legacy access pattern; Databricks recommends Unity Catalog volumes or external locations.
rules.recommendation: Read from Unity Catalog volumes (/Volumes/<catalog>/<schema>/<volume>) or external locations.

rules.title: Legacy Spark SQL configuration flags
rules.description: spark.sql.legacy.* flags restore old behaviour and may be removed in later Spark versions.
rules.recommendation: Remove the flag and fix the code for the new behaviour, or document why it is still needed.
